## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **`Page n/N`, not "Page n of N".** The figure gate's material-numeral
   scanner exempts the `x/y` form (it is the date/enumerator shape);
   a page index is chrome, never a count claim — it must not read as
   a material number on a record surface.
2. **The brief's at-a-glance counts render inside figure regions.**
   The glance `<dd>` values are material numbers, so `dossierFigureSpecs
   (…, "print")` emits `glance-recorded`/`glance-unknown` specs and the
   brief wraps the cells in `<Figure order="inline">` — the same
   registry, pointer at the document root (the audit spans the whole
   artifact). `check:figures` reports 0 bare numerals on every print
   page.
3. **The JD copy bindings stay in the route file.** The P34.14 binder
   tests parse `print.astro` source — moving JD-02/JD-07/JD-08 into
   components orphaned them (caught by `make check`, fixed in-commit):
   the combines/unmapped sentences render through a named slot on
   `CouncilBrief`, the release stamp through the default slot on
   `PrintChrome`. Literal markup stays where the binder can see it.
4. **Adjacent inline elements carry `{" "}` separators.** The K14
   glue check (NEW-7) flagged the runhead/footer/figcaption span runs;
   whitespace now separates every inline sibling in the print chrome —
   visual layout is unchanged (the spans are block/flex children).
5. **A QR encoder, not a dependency.** `check-licenses` permits only
   OSI-permissive deps and a QR path adds a transitive surface; the
   ~460-line encoder is spec-verbatim (byte mode, EC-M, v1–10) and
   independently verified — `segno` matrices where comparable (several
   `segno` defaults pick Micro/segmented variants, so matrix diffs are
   explained by variant, never silently), `reedsolo` parity bytes, and
   OpenCV decode of rendered PNGs.
6. **Stale allow-list entry pruned.** `dossier/unplaced/index.html`'s
   `placement@1` exemption matched nothing (the ruleset name stopped
   rendering as a bare numeral); the checker's own stale-entry report
   directed the prune — registry data, not a material number.
7. **No ADR.** Every shape executes the K14 UXK14-9 contract — the
   plan cell carries no answered decision lines to carry.
